goal_summary: Re-test whether the repository's existing defensive CS2 demo anomaly project can execute its current parser-to-report workflow on an authorized cached real Demo without network or source edits.

capability_gap.summary: The default Python environment cannot import demoparser2, the formal Provider candidate is still NEEDS_REWORK, and current capability must be verified from executable evidence while preserving conservative anti-cheat conclusions.

selected_items.summary: The working project is a defensive authorized-Demo analyzer with bounded public discovery, demoparser2 normalization, explainable player-level windows, unknown-information handling, no automatic ban, and no claimed accuracy from unlabeled data.

The last isolated retest reported 28 passing tests and a genuine public CS2 parse with 369414 rows, 39949 ticks, 10 players, 2764 raw weapon_fire events, 2189 attributable shots, accuracy NOT_EVALUATED, no automatic ban, and required human review.
The working-project real-demo retest passed with limits, while the independently generated formal Provider candidate remained NEEDS_REWORK with 49 failures and 42 passes and no delivery artifact.
The preserved report binds the verified public source and real parser counts to conservative per-player insufficient_corroboration outcomes and explicit evidence limitations.

failure_evidence.summary: The default repository Python cannot import demoparser2, but the previously verified isolated virtual environment and cached genuine CS2 Demo files remain available. The test must use the preserved environment and make no new download.
